title: Corelink CW2P2P 2-Port 1G EPON OLT Dual Power | 1:128 ONU Support

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Corelink CW2P2P 2-Port 1G EPON OLT is a high-performance fiber access solution designed for FTTH, FTTB, and ISP networks. With 2 EPON ports supporting up to 1:128 ONU splitting ratio, this OLT ensures efficient bandwidth distribution and scalable fiber deployment for small to medium-sized ISPs.


Equipped with dual power supply support, the device provides enhanced reliability and uninterrupted operation, making it ideal for mission-critical network environments. The OLT delivers stable Gigabit uplink performance, ensuring smooth data transmission across connected ONUs.


The Corelink CW2P2P supports advanced features such as VLAN, QoS, bandwidth control, port isolation, and remote ONU management, enabling network administrators to efficiently control and optimize network performance.


Designed for rackmount installation, this EPON OLT is compact, energy-efficient, and easy to deploy, making it a perfect choice for growing broadband service providers.


Key Features


  • 2 × 1G EPON ports
  • Supports up to 1:128 ONU split ratio
  • Dual power supply for redundancy
  • High-performance Gigabit uplink
  • Advanced VLAN, QoS, and bandwidth control
  • Remote ONU management support
  • Stable and reliable FTTH deployment
  • Compact rackmount design
  • Ideal for ISP and fiber network solutions
